timeline: Brush fire reported near Portico Del Norte, San Clemente (OCFA).
Three type-1 strike teams (15 engines) requested; air tankers on no-divert for structure protection.
Reports of a second start at Via La Mirada corrected: spotting from the Norte Fire, not a new fire.
Multiple structures impacted near Via La Mirada and Calle Esperanza; threats at Avenida California and Paseo Aliso. 10 more strike teams (50 engines) requested.
OCFA estimate 50 to 70 acres, dangerous rate of spread. Homes on Avenida Placida threatened (KNX).
Evacuation requested for all streets off Camino Las Ramblas down to I-5 and around to the San Juan dump. Fire impacting homes at Avenida Calita, Via La Mirada, Via De Agua.
Evacuation orders: San Juan Capistrano zones 4, 5, 10 and San Clemente zones 12, 13 (OCFA via Genasys).
Mission Viejo: smoke visible but no current threat to the city. Santa Ana winds expected through Saturday.
OCFA: fire now 250 acres, immediate structure threat. Three air tankers approved on no-divert.
Prima Deshecha Landfill closed (OC Waste & Recycling). Homes impacted at Avenida Calita, Via La Mirada, Via De Agua.
I-5 closed in both directions south of San Clemente because of the separate Henderson Fire at Camp Pendleton (CNS). Follow deputies' directions for routes.
Homes burning on Via La Mirada seen on live broadcast; right flank moving down toward houses (radio traffic).
Order zones restated: SCL12, SCL13, SJC04, SJC05, SJC10 (OC alert).
Crews requested (scanner report, not yet an official order): hard road closure on I-5 from San Juan Creek Rd to Camino De Los Mares (radio traffic via Watch Duty).
Capistrano Unified: nine San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano schools dismissing early; parents asked to pick up students (OC Register).
Fire continues west; front reported about half a mile from I-5 with heavy smoke over the freeway in San Juan Capistrano. Homes lost on Via La Mirada.
Units requested to La Novia Ave and Via Cerro Rebal for an immediate structure threat; additional resource request placed (radio traffic via Watch Duty).
Crews requested (scanner report): Avenida La Pata closure southbound, Ortega Hwy to Avenida Vista Hermosa. Resource order: 50 type-1 engines, 15 type-3 engines, 3 hand crews, 6 dozers.
Evacuation shelters open: San Juan Capistrano Community Center (25925 Camino del Avion) and San Clemente Community Center (100 Calle Seville), per OCFA.

Capistrano Unified dismissing nine schools early: Bernice Ayer MS, Clarence Lobo ES, Concordia ES, Harold Ambuehl ES, San Clemente HS, San Juan Hills HS, Shorecliffs MS, Truman Benedict ES, Vista Del Mar. Elementary parents go to the school for pickup (OC Dept of Education).
ABC7: at least 4 homes destroyed in the San Clemente / San Juan Capistrano area. Not yet in an OCFA count.
FIRIS (OES Intel 24) mapped the fire at 465.5 acres. Perimeters are preliminary; a home inside the perimeter is not necessarily damaged.
Six air tankers released and the no-divert status lifted, per Air Attack (via Watch Duty). A sign the air fight is winding down, not that orders are lifted.
KTLA: at least six homes burned in San Juan Capistrano neighborhoods. OCFA's official count still pending inspection.
OCFA: at least six homes damaged or destroyed (via news reports).
OCFA via ABC7: one firefighter injured from heat exhaustion; six homes damaged or destroyed.

OCFA press conference: 0% contained; objective is to hold the fire inside its current perimeter. 400 personnel assigned, 400 more responding, crews out all night and into the weekend. Both shelters remain open and accept small pets. Repopulation not until deemed safe. Public information hotline 714-628-7085.
FIRIS (OES Intel 24) remapped the fire at 570.3 acres, up from 465.5. Growth is inside the earlier footprint area, not a new run.

OC Sheriff: overnight shelter open at the Boys & Girls Club, 1 Via Positiva, San Juan Capistrano, animals allowed. Community centers become 8 AM to 8 PM care and reception. Animal shelters: OC Animal Care, 1630 Victory Rd, Tustin (SJC residents) and CASA, 221 Avenida Fabricante, San Clemente (intake until 7 PM, reopens 7 AM).
OCFA night update: all evacuation orders remain in effect. Crews working through the night to protect homes.
front_note: Western head near Via La Mirada, Via De Agua and Avenida Calita (1:02 PM radio traffic) plus the north flank at Via Cerro Rebal (1:54 PM)
closures: Avenida La Pata southbound closed between Ortega Hwy and Avenida Vista Hermosa (requested 1:54 PM)
Nine Capistrano Unified schools dismissing early (check school messages)
I-5 hard closure requested from San Juan Creek Rd to Camino De Los Mares (radio traffic 1:29 PM)
I-5 closed both directions south of San Clemente (Henderson Fire, Camp Pendleton)

shelters.note: Open overnight. Animals allowed. Bring medications.

shelters.addr: 25925 Camino del Avion, San Juan Capistrano
shelters.note: Care and reception 8 AM to 8 PM. Small pets accepted.

shelters.name: San Clemente Community Center
shelters.note: Care and reception 8 AM to 8 PM. Small pets accepted.

schools.note: Capistrano Unified: nine schools dismissing early. Elementary: parents report to the school for pickup. Secondary: pick up or authorize release via school messages.

damage: OCFA: at least six homes damaged or destroyed, on Via La Mirada and nearby (reported 5:44 PM). Broadcast video and photos suggest the count may be higher. Final numbers come after damage inspection.
injuries: One firefighter treated for heat exhaustion (OCFA via ABC7). No civilian injuries reported.
shelter_note: Per OC Sheriff at 8:12 PM. The Boys & Girls Club is the overnight shelter and allows animals. The two community centers run care and reception 8 AM to 8 PM. Bring medicines, ID and chargers. If you need a ride, call 911.

animal_shelters.name: OC Animal Care emergency shelter (dogs, cats, small pets)
animal_shelters.note: For San Juan Capistrano evacuees. Bring photo ID, vaccination records, special food, medications. Pets or large animals: 714-935-6848 (8 AM to 5 PM) or 714-259-1122 (5 PM to 8 AM).

animal_shelters.name: San Clemente / Dana Point Animal Shelter (CASA)
animal_shelters.note: Accepting pets from San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano evacuees. Intake until 7 PM, reopens 7 AM.
